run_cfr_solver: run CFR algorithm on a sequential game to compute an approximate Nash policy
run_cfr_plus_solver: run CFR+ algorithm on a sequential game using regret matching plus and alternating updates
compute_counterfactual_regret: compute counterfactual regrets and update cumulative policy for a player in a game tree
apply_regret_matching_plus_reset: reset negative cumulative regrets to zero for all information states
update_average_policy: update the average policy from accumulated policy probabilities across iterations
